children: Kyntra Bio entered into an amended and restated Revenue Interest Financing Agreement with NQ Project Phoebus to materially reduce future payment obligations. The amendment lowers the maximum aggregate payments to $65 million from $125 million and eliminates all future true-up payments. In exchange, Kyntra Bio made a $42.6 million accelerated upfront payment. Management expects the revised terms to improve long-term cash flow predictability.
